title: Strict Gate Transformation
statement: For each natural number $n$, define a transformation of gates as follows: an empty-input conjunction becomes a disjunction reading vertices $n+1,n+2$, and an empty-input disjunction becomes a conjunction reading those vertices. A one-input conjunction reading $a$ becomes a conjunction reading the shifted index of $a$ and $n+1$; a one-input disjunction reading $a$ becomes a disjunction reading the shifted index of $a$ and $n+2$. In all other cases, retain the gate operation and shift every input index by the prefix shift.
